a.xlink:title: Encodes one PUS-A TM secondary header into caller-owned storage.
Returns exact encoded size for valid PUS-A TM tailoring, otherwise zero.
Encodes one numeric CUC value directly into caller-owned storage.
Stores the low-order 0..8 octets using explicit wire byte order.
Returns non-zero when value fits exactly within the selected identifier width.
Returns the encoded P-field + T-field size without validating the layout.
Validates the supported basic CUC layout.
Stores 0..8 octets in CCSDS-standard big-endian order.
Returns non-zero for supported mission identifier widths 0, 1, 2, or 4 octets.
